ruleDefinitions.name: Startup Folder File Write
ruleDefinitions.description: A General detection for files being created in the Windows startup directory. This could be an indicator of persistence.

sequences.query: file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\Start\\ Menu\\\\Programs\\\\StartUp.*") AND  NOT ((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\wuauclt\.exe" OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\\\$WINDOWS\\\.\\~BT\\\\NewOS\\\\")))
